name: Polkit - PwnKit (CVE-2021-4034)
description: PwnKit is a memory-corruption bug in polkit's pkexec (SUID root) present for 12+ years, giving any local user instant root. Compile the tiny PoC and run it.

steps.label: 2. Clone + compile
steps.command:
git clone https://github.com/arthepsy/CVE-2021-4034.git && cd CVE-2021-4034
gcc cve-2021-4034-poc.c -o poc

defense.why_it_works: PwnKit (CVE-2021-4034) exploits a memory corruption vulnerability in pkexec, the setuid binary of the polkit privilege manager. An out-of-bounds write in argument processing allows an attacker to manipulate environment variables in a way that causes pkexec to execute attacker-controlled code with root privileges, even without sudo access.
defense.prerequisites: Local user account. pkexec binary present with setuid bit (default installation). Vulnerable polkit version (< 0.120 with patch, specific to all major distros through early 2022).
defense.impact: Instant local root access. No sudo privileges required. Works even when sudoers restricts the user to nothing. Affects virtually all major Linux distributions.
defense.detection: Execution of pkexec exploit binary (unusual pkexec usage with specific argument patterns). EDR: uid escalation 1000->0 via pkexec process. Kernel/auditd: SEGFAULT or unusual memory mapping from pkexec.
defense.artifacts: Process audit: pkexec with exploit args executed by non-root | EDR: uid change via pkexec | Application log: polkit error messages
defense.prevention: Update polkit immediately (package: policykit-1 on Debian/Ubuntu). Patch was released January 2022. As a temporary mitigation, remove SUID from pkexec: chmod 0755 /usr/bin/pkexec (breaks PolicyKit functionality). Monitor for CVE-2021-4034 exploit signatures.
defense.misconfiguration: Vulnerable polkit version installed (< 0.120 with January 2022 patch). pkexec has setuid bit (default). System not patched since early 2022.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Vulnerable pkexec
ls -la /usr/bin/pkexec
# -rwsr-xr-x 1 root root ... /usr/bin/pkexec

pkexec --version
# pkexec version 0.105  <- vulnerable
defense.secure_config:
# Update polkit
apt update && apt install --only-upgrade policykit-1

# Verify patch
pkexec --version  # should be 0.120+

# Temporary mitigation (breaks PolicyKit)
chmod 0755 /usr/bin/pkexec
